court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Arulmighu Prasanna Venkatramanaswami Temple Rep. by its Temporary Trustee … Respondent(s).
case_number: CMP No. 7133 of 2025 and SA Sr No. 7811 of 2023
advocates: For Appellant(s): Mr. Samjayarah Houston for M/s. Sarvabhauman Associates
judgment_text:
Prayer in CMP No. 7133 of 2025: This petition is filed to condone the delay of 249 days in filing the above second appeal SA.SR. No. 7811/2023.

Prayer in SA Sr No. 7811 of 2023: second appeal is filed under Section 100 CPC to set aside the judgment and decree dated 2-9-2021 in A.S. No. 37 of 2020 on the file of principal Sub Court, Namakkal, confirming the judgment and decree dated 23-9-2019 passed in O.S. No. 564 of 2012 on the file of Additional District Munsif, Namakkal.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Sounthar, J.:— It is seen from the records that the death of sole respondent was recorded as early as on 5-3-2026 and at request of the learned counsel for the petitioner, this petition was adjourned to 23-3-2026. On 23-3-2026 also, at request of the learned counsel for the petitioner, the matter was adjourned to 10-4-2026. On 10-4-2026, again, the learned counsel for the petitioner sought time to take steps. In order to give one more opportunity to the petitioner, this matter was again adjourned to 29-4-2026, finally.

2. Even today also, the petitioner has not taken steps to bring on record the L.Rs of the deceased sole respondent. Hence, this petition is dismissed as abated. As a necessary consequence, the second appeal is rejected in the SR stage itself. There shall be no order as to costs.
